## Textbook practice {#practice}

CambridgeMATHS NSW Year 10, Stage 5 Core & Advanced/Extension Paths, third edition (2024). **Exercise 5A.**

| Time | Core practice |
|:--|:--|
| 5 min | p. 365. Q1(g, k), Q2(c). Expand each bracket, keeping the sign with its multiplier. |
| 8 min | p. 365. Q3(d, h), Q4(a, d, i). For Q4, write the identity you recognise before expanding. |
| 12 min | p. 366. Q5(d, m, g, o, c). Work in this order. Choose your own method for each part. |
| 10 min | p. 366, Q8(a). Expand both products and simplify. Then do p. 367, Q11(a). Identify the error and correct the working. |
| 5 min | Check your answers on p. 906. Redo a missed part from a blank line. If all are correct, verify Q5(o) using FOIL. |
